reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Mavericks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 51 times in 100; most games like this end between 208 and 256 total points.

analyst.text: Dallas were embarrassed 133-94 in Minnesota, which snapped their three-game win streak; Cooper Flagg managed 12 points two nights after scoring 43. A blowout like that often brings a sharper response. Cleveland are on the second night of a back-to-back after visiting Miami and remain without Evan Mobley (toe). The mental picture is balanced, with a slight lean to a motivated Dallas against a tired, short-handed Cavs side.
